source_truth.placement_claim: shared non-diegetic/area public-space atmosphere only; it does not assert a specific vehicle, stop, announcement or event at the listener position

authorship.method: deterministic procedural PCM synthesized in project-authored GDScript
authorship.licensing: original project-authored code and generated PCM; no third-party audio file redistributed

reuse_scope: Shared ambience candidate for Centre, Midi and Ixelles public-space gameplay. The base layer intentionally carries no stop-, route-, timetable- or vehicle-specific semantics; future location-specific layers require their own source gate.
acceptance_note: Human listening remains decisive. Spectral/loudness measurements only prove deterministic audibility and integrity, not Brussels recognition or aesthetic quality.
